### Opportunity requirements
**1.**
**Refer to EOI document suite provided in the Data Room**
Transport for NSW (TfNSW) invites from suitably experienced tenderers to undertake the Collaborative Design and Construction (CD&C) of Mona Vale Road West Upgrade. The pre-qualified contractors with Transport for NSW under the National Prequalification Scheme R4, B4 and F100 category. The Design Contractor to be prequalified under TfNSW Technical scheme such as Drainage investigation and design, Complex Road Design and Complex Bridge Design.
Transport for NSW (TfNSW) are preparing the reference design, business case and the feasibility studies for the Mona Vale Road Upgrade West project which is located on Mona Vale Road between McCarrs Creek Road, Terrey Hills and Powder Works Road, Ingleside in the Northern Beaches Local Government Area. The Project’s scope of work will include the investigation, design, construction, testing and commissioning of the Project in accordance with the requirements of the Contract, including the Scope of Works and Technical Criteria (SWTC) and the environmental documents.
TfNSW proposes to upgrade about 3.7 kilometres of Mona Vale Road, currently a two (2) lane road, between McCarrs Creek Road and Powderworks Road, to a four (4) lane divided road.
The works under the contract is to be carried out with the least possible disruption to traffic and access to nearby residences and businesses.
EOI Tender closing time and date is **3:00 pm on Friday 11 September 2026**.
**This is an open tender.**
**EOI Briefing**
An EOI Briefing will be held at **10:00 am on Thursday, 6 August 2026** via **MS Team**. Attendance is not mandatory to submit a conforming tender.
RSVP: Applicants must register at least [1] day prior via email to [MVRWProcurement@transport.nsw.gov.au](mailto:MVRWProcurement@transport.nsw.gov.au)
**Data Room Access**
Access to the Data Room will be provided only to those who register their interest by 5 August 2026 and submit an executed copy of the Confidentiality Deed Poll (CDP) attached in this advertisement (in accordance with the instructions in that deed) to the contact officer, Fion Chan at [MVRWProcurement@transport.nsw.gov.au](mailto:MVRWProcurement@transport.nsw.gov.au) prior to being given access to the data room to view and download EOI documents.
All tenderers must comply with the [**Transport Statement of Business Ethics**](https://www.transport.nsw.gov.au/system/files/media/documents/2022/statement-of-business-ethics_0.pdf) through the procurement process and any subsequent contract period.
All tenderers must comply with the NSW Government [**Procurement Policy Framework**](https://buy.nsw.gov.au/policy-library/policies/procurement-policy-framework), NSW Government [**Supplier Code of Conduct**](https://info.buy.nsw.gov.au/policy-library/policies/supplier-code-of-conduct) and [**New South Wales Industrial Relations Guidelines: Building and Construction Procurement**](https://www.industrialrelations.nsw.gov.au/assets/Uploads/publications/CCU-related-documents/nsw_ir_guidelines_building_and_construction_procurement.pdf).
**This Project is jointly funded by the Australian and NSW Government.**
It is a requirement for this Project that the successful contractor be accredited under the Australian Government Work Health and Safety Accreditation Scheme (the Scheme) at the time of entering into the contract for ‘building work’ for the Project and must maintain accreditation under the Scheme while the ‘building work’ is being carried out. Information on the Scheme is available on the Australian Government website at [**www.fsc.gov.au**](http://www.fsc.gov.au).
